svg.title: Figure S10
svg.desc: Figure S10. A published Sanger study from another laboratory re-analysed automatically: mutations per sequence, the substitution spectrum, the four mutation classes the paper tests, and its claims against what SHMtrace finds.

tspan.tspan: 2,804 of the 2,809 mutations the paper counts; r = 1.0000 over the 60 spectrum cells of (B); 1,795 clones, 40 animals, 2 s.
